title: 第8章 给他娶媳妇
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: “行啊，弟弟有出息了，哥也能跟着沾光啦！”刘烨很高兴，腾出一只手，用力地捶了一下刘宇宁的肩膀。“哟，这手臂还怪粗的，这么硬，看来在部队没少锻炼。”嘿嘿……刘宇宁又故意亮了亮自己的臂肌，语气带着一丝挑衅。“明天晚上咱们掰个手腕试试，看我这几年锻炼出来的力气，能不能跟你一较高下。”“我每次锻炼就一个信念，回来必须得赢你一次。”“哈哈哈……”刘烨大笑起来，一脸自信，“比就比！”王秀菊一路小跑跟在两人后面，脸色很不好看。儿子要给这个八竿子都打不着的傻大个娶媳妇！凭什么？！就因为同姓刘？又穷又能吃，这得砸多少钱，才有姑娘愿意嫁过来？！再说，儿子自己也到结婚的年纪了，还没有一点谱。要是将来真娶个单位里的媳妇，彩礼肯定也得天价……等刘烨到了家，王秀菊赶上刘宇宁的脚步，小声问。“宇宁，你明天真拿钱给刘烨？要拿多少？”刘宇宁点点头，“这事我还得问问您，找媒人说媒，一般要给多少钱合适？”“十块八块，都有……”王秀菊不太愿意说，但又担心儿子给太多，肉疼。“你不会真准备给刘烨找媳妇吧？现在彩礼都要很多的，得好几百呢！”想到家里那为数不太多的积蓄，王秀菊现在就开始牙疼上火了。钱，都是儿子当兵寄回来存下的，他们平常都没舍得动，就想着等他回来娶媳妇用。“没事妈，我工作以后有工资，一个月一两百应该有的。”刘宇宁一听几百彩礼钱，心里有谱了。“烨哥跟我一起玩到大的，村里同姓刘的就咱们两家人，说不定上几辈是一家人也说不准。”“咱家好过了，就冲他也姓刘，咱拉拔他一下也不是多难的事。”“他有力气，又勤快，只是少了人帮衬，我们帮帮他，好吗？”他说得无比认真，王秀菊一听，满口的牙都像突然长了蛀虫，疼得脑门嗡嗡响。“你就是心太好……”她喃了一句，等下回家，必须让老头子一起劝劝才行。……徐喜弟回到家，脸色已经恢复如常。她刚刚还没吃粥，就赶着出去找巴儿姐，这会儿都已经午饭时间了。范金花又煮了一锅粥，炒了一碗腌萝卜。张国海从屋里出来，手里拿一个盆，里面放着一条邋遢的裤子，黑着脸去后院。路过的时候，徐喜弟闻到那股臭味，差点就吐了。从前伺候张永福邋遢习惯了，憋一口气就能熬过去。这才两天没碰，她竟然嫌恶起来。有点不敢想，哪天公婆又突然让她去伺候，日子该怎么熬……巴儿姐可不管那么多，舌头一吐，yue了一声，十分嫌弃。“阿巴巴，阿巴巴……”谁也听不懂她说什么。等张国海洗好了裤子晾上，一家人才围着灶吃午饭。张国海慢悠悠吃着粥，给张永福装好的那碗，就放在灶上，他也不着急端进去。范金花也不管，吃完饭就自顾忙着去剁菜煮猪食。“徐喜弟，贱人，你还不来见我！”“你们想饿死我！”“你们嫌我累赘，那我死好了！”张永福咒骂的声音，再次从公婆的房间里传出来。徐喜弟知道，公婆给他换了房间，晚上巴儿姐和他一起睡。天天听他骂，所有人都已经麻木了。眼看巴儿姐吃饱饭又准备出去溜达，徐喜弟连忙拉住她。“以后你不能自己出门，要么跟我们去干活，要么待在家。”徐喜弟一边说一边用手比划，也不知道巴儿姐听没听懂。“巴巴，阿巴巴……”被困在家里不乐意，倒是让她巴巴得很明显。“你能管她，那你管了……”范金花一边剁菜，一边讥诮了一句。徐喜弟哼了一声，直接将人拉到自己屋里，然后关上房门。两人坐在床上，大眼瞪小眼，反正不能给她出去。巴儿姐巴巴好一阵，最后干脆躺床上睡觉。徐喜弟也睡。两人就这样一直睡到太阳下山。“去帮忙剁菜。”她拉着巴儿姐出房门，指着墙角的猪菜。从前都由着巴儿姐的性子来，那时候她得管张永福，也没什么精力。这两天闲下来，她就觉得，巴儿姐也必须得管管，得让她学着分担家务。否则将来怎么办？巴儿姐有将来吗？她都不敢往远了想。巴儿姐鼓着嘴，蹲过去剁菜，大大小小，乱七八糟。范金花听见动静，从火房出来，看到一地狼藉，也不说话，又转头走了。……吃过晚饭，徐喜弟又指挥巴儿姐去洗碗。完了又扫地，还让帮忙去喂猪。巴儿姐翻了无数个白眼，徐喜弟只当没看见。冲凉后，巴儿姐不愿意跟弟弟睡了，冲进徐喜弟的房间，然后被范金花连拉带拽弄了出去。徐喜弟十分疑惑，巴儿姐不能跟她睡？“让她跟我睡呗？”“她跟你睡，夜里谁照顾永福？”范金花带上了门。徐喜弟愣了，她以后都不用跟张永福睡一张床了吗？会不会太幸福？要是生个孩子，不用再伺候张永福，她也不是非要离开这个家不可。想到这，她摸着自己的肚子，不知道怀上了没？白天睡了一觉，夜晚就特别清醒。黑暗中睁着眼，怎么都睡不着。家里已经彻底安静下来，她还在叹气。忽然吱呀一声，房门被轻轻推开，一道身影闪了进来。？？今晚还要办事吗？徐喜弟紧张地坐起身，正好对方也熟门熟路坐到她跟前。今天他并不着急，缓慢地脱鞋脱衣服。脱完了才凑过来，一把搂住她。搂了许久都没动，最后拉起她的手，捏在掌中轻揉。办过两回事，徐喜弟已经有了充分的心理准备。但她不懂要怎么做，就只任由他捏着她的手，送到嘴边，吻了又吻。手背亲了一遍，又换到手心。徐喜弟痒得全身一个激灵，忍不住说了一句，“痒……还是赶紧的吧。”可他依旧不急，伸手精准地抵住她的唇，让她别说话。徐喜弟心跳都快蹦出膛了。这，这有点磨人呐！
content_en: "Okay, my younger brother has become promising, and my brother can also benefit from it!" Liu Ye was very happy, freed up a hand, and punched Liu Yuning's shoulder hard."Hey, these arms are really thick and hard. It seems that they have been exercising a lot in the army." Hehe... Liu Yuning deliberately showed off his arm muscles again, with a hint of provocation in his tone."Let's give it a try tomorrow night and see if I can compete with you with the strength I have developed over the past few years." "Every time I exercise, I have one belief. I must beat you once when I come back." "Hahaha..." Liu Ye laughed, with a confident look on his face, "Let's compete!" Wang Xiuju trotted behind the two of them, with a very ugly look on her face.My son wants to find a wife for this stupid guy who can’t even fight!Why?!Just because they have the same surname as Liu?You are poor and have enough to eat. How much money do you have to spend to get a girl willing to marry you?!Besides, the son himself has reached the age of marriage, and he doesn’t have any skills yet.If he really marries a wife from his work unit in the future, the bride price will definitely be sky-high... When Liu Ye arrived home, Wang Xiuju caught up with Liu Yuning and asked in a low voice."Yuning, are you really going to give money to Liu Ye tomorrow? How much will you give?" Liu Yuning nodded, "I have to ask you about this, how much should I give to a matchmaker?" "Ten or eight yuan, everything..." Wang Xiuju was reluctant to say, but she was worried that her son would feel hurt if he gave too much."You're not really going to find a wife for Liu Ye, are you? Nowadays, the betrothal gifts are very large, hundreds of dollars!" Thinking of the small savings at home, Wang Xiuju started to get a toothache and get angry.The money was all sent back by their son when he was a soldier. They were usually reluctant to touch it, just thinking about waiting for him to get a wife when he came back."It's okay, Mom, I will get a salary after working. I should have one or two hundred a month." Liu Yuning felt enlightened when he heard the gift money was several hundred."Brother Ye has been playing with me since we grew up. We are the only two families with the same surname Liu in the village. Maybe we were the same family several generations ago." "Our family is better off, so let's give him the surname Liu. It won't be difficult for us to pull him out.""He is strong and diligent, but he lacks support. Let's help him, okay?"He said very seriously. When Wang Xiuju heard this, her teeth felt like they suddenly had cavities, and her forehead buzzed with pain."You just have a good heart..." She murmured, and she had to let the old man persuade her when she got home later....Xu Xidi returned home and his complexion returned to normal.She hadn't eaten her porridge just now, so she hurried out to find Sister Ba'er. It was already lunch time.Fan Jinhua cooked another pot of porridge and fried a bowl of pickled radish.Zhang Guohai came out of the house, holding a basin with a pair of sloppy pants in his hand, and went to the backyard with a dark face.When passing by, Xu Xidi almost vomited when he smelled the stench.In the past, I was used to being sloppy when serving Zhang Yongfu, so I could get through it by holding my breath.It had only been two days since she had touched it, and she actually felt disgusted.I don't dare to think about how she will survive the day when her parents-in-law suddenly ask her to take care of her again... Sister Ba'er doesn't care about that much. She stuck out her tongue and yawned, feeling very disgusted."Ababa, Ababa..." No one could understand what she said.After Zhang Guohai washed his pants and hung them to dry, the family gathered around the stove for lunch.Zhang Guohai ate the porridge slowly. The bowl he had packed for Zhang Yongfu was placed on the stove, and he was not in a hurry to take it in.Fan Jinhua didn't care. After eating, he went to chop vegetables and cook pig food."Xu Xidi, bitch, you haven't come to see me yet!" "You want to starve me to death!" "You think I'm a burden, so I'll die!" Zhang Yongfu's cursing voice came from the room of his parents-in-law again.Xu Xidi knew that his parents-in-law changed his room and Sister Baer slept with him at night.Listening to him scolding every day, everyone has become numb.Seeing that Sister Ba'er had finished her meal and was about to go out for a walk, Xu Xidi quickly grabbed her."You can't go out by yourself from now on. Either you go to work with us or stay at home." Xu Xidi gestured with his hands as he spoke. I don't know if Sister Ba'er understood."Baba, Ababa..." She was not happy being trapped at home, but it made her baba very obvious."You can take care of her, then you can take care of her..." Fan Jinhua said sarcastically while chopping vegetables.Xu Xidi snorted, pulled the person into his room, and closed the door.The two of them sat on the bed, staring at each other, unable to let her out anyway.Sister Baer was fussy for a while, and finally she just lay down on the bed and slept.Xu Xidi also slept.The two slept like this until the sun went down."Go help chop vegetables." She pulled Sister Ba'er out of the room and pointed to the vegetables in the corner.In the past, it was always up to Sister Ba'er's temper. At that time, she had to take care of Zhang Yongfu and didn't have much energy.After these two days of free time, she felt that Sister Baer must also be taken care of and let her learn to share the housework.Otherwise, what will happen in the future?Does Sister Baer have a future?She didn't dare to think further.Sister Ba'er bulged her mouth and squatted down to chop vegetables, large and small, in a mess.Fan Jinhua heard the commotion and came out of the fire room. When she saw the mess, she turned around and left without saying anything....After dinner, Xu Xidi directed Sister Baer to wash the dishes.After I finished, I swept the floor again and asked help to feed the pigs.Sister Ba'er rolled her eyes countless times, but Xu Xidi just pretended not to see it.After taking a shower, Sister Ba'er didn't want to sleep with her brother anymore. She rushed into Xu Xidi's room and was dragged out by Fan Jinhua.Xu Xidi was very confused. Sister Ba'er couldn't sleep with her?"Let her sleep with me?" "If she sleeps with you, who will take care of Yongfu at night?" Fan Jinhua closed the door.Xu Xidi was stunned. She wouldn't have to sleep in the same bed with Zhang Yongfu anymore?Wouldn't it be too happy?If she gives birth to a child and no longer has to serve Zhang Yongfu, she doesn't have to leave this home.Thinking of this, she touched her belly, wondering if she was pregnant?After sleeping during the day, I feel particularly awake at night.I kept my eyes open in the dark, unable to fall asleep no matter what.The house was completely quiet, and she was still sighing.Suddenly there was a creak, the door was gently pushed open, and a figure flashed in.??Do you have anything else to do tonight?Xu Xidi sat up nervously, and the other party happened to sit in front of her in a familiar way.Today he was in no rush, taking off his shoes and clothes slowly.After he finished taking off his clothes, he came over and hugged her.After hugging her for a long time without moving, he finally took her hand, held it in his palm and rubbed it gently.Having done two things, Xu Xidi was fully mentally prepared.But she didn't know what to do, so she just let him hold her hand, bring it to his mouth, and kiss her again and again.Kissed the back of the hand once, then moved to the palm of the hand.Xu Xidi was so itchy that his whole body trembled, and he couldn't help but say, "It's itchy... you'd better hurry up." But he was still in no hurry, and reached out to touch her lips accurately to stop her from talking.Xu Xidi's heartbeat almost jumped out of his chest.This, this is a bit annoying!
